messages:
Ellen Park: Quick ask 101: ACME hit a renewal risk after a weekend ramp. Can we produce a tiny customer-facing "Quick Enablement" checklist for prefill + batch + streaming they can run in a 15-min call?
Ravi Desai: Yes. Make it action-first: 5 checklist bullets, one curl example, one jitter schedule, and 3 plain metrics to watch.
Marta Gonzalez: Metrics to surface: prefill_success_rate, stream_p95_ms, inflight_queue_len. Call out simple alarm thresholds customers can use.
Ellen Park: For thresholds proposal: GOOD if prefill_success_rate >= 75% & stream_p95_ms < 500ms; WATCH if prefill_success_rate 55-75% or stream_p95_ms 500-800ms; ATTENTION if prefill_success_rate < 55% or stream_p95_ms > 800ms or sustained 5xx. Keep colors non-technical.
Owen Li: Quick curl example to paste: 
```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/prefill \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -d '{"tenant":"acme","prompts":["short_welcome","summary"],"parallel":2}'
```
And jitter suggestion: schedule every 5m + rand(-30s..30s).
Ravi Desai: Operational knobs (customer wording): cache TTLs: ephemeral=5m, session=1h, static=12h. Batch guidance: try 2-4 items for low-latency apps. Client timeout: set ~12s, then fallback to streaming with max_chunk_tokens=64.
Marta Gonzalez: Renewal note: if ATTENTION persists for 48h, ask customer to either request a temporary warm pool (support@redwood.ai, include tenant id & expected peak qps) or schedule a troubleshooting call.
HealthBot: Draft uploaded internally: https://confluence.redwood.ai/cs/quick-enablement-prefill (internal). Replace internal emails with support@redwood.ai for public copy.
Ellen Park: Also include a short email template CS can send (1 line subject + 3 bullets) and a tiny feedback gadget idea (thumbs up / down + 1-line "what changed"). We will add a calendar link for urgent escalations.
Owen Li: I'll assemble the 1-pager and the friendly thresholds table. Target: publish to CS enablement repo by tomorrow morning.
Ravi Desai: I'll add a one-line Grafana alert snippet customers can paste.
Marta Gonzalez: Closing thread 101. Post final public link here when ready. :white_check_mark:
